For a unital map of commutative rings $u:R\to S$, going down means: for every chain $\mathfrak p\subset\mathfrak p^\prime$ in $\operatorname{Spec}R$ and $\mathfrak q^\prime$ over $\mathfrak p^\prime$, there exists $\mathfrak q\subset\mathfrak q^\prime$ over $\mathfrak p$.
